content.text: Do we want to support import that loses these dates?  The only advantage I can think of is that people can run the import feature against pre 4.7.4 repositories.
I think we should support pre-4.7.4 repositories (and people who disable the relaxed server-managed triples behavior for whatever reason).
Pending response to minor code review comments.
I believe I have addressed your comments.
Sorry for the back and forth... but I hope we are on the last round.
No problem.  I hope it's perfect this time.
This will only work against a currently unreleasesd version of fedora.
